crossRefs.note: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that…
crossRefs.keyword: or, God is a righteous Judge

crossRefs.note: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
crossRefs.keyword: or, God is a righteous Judge

crossRefs.note: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
crossRefs.keyword: or, God is a righteous Judge

crossRefs.note: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
crossRefs.keyword: or, God is a righteous Judge

translations.web: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
translations.bsb: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.
translations.kjv: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
translations.asv: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.
